prompt: Count the business days (Monday-Friday) remaining until a deadline: every day after 'from' up to and including 'to'. Complete businessDaysUntil in Deadlines.
explanation: Starting the walk at from.plusDays(1) makes the range exclusive of 'from', and looping while !day.isAfter(to) makes it inclusive of 'to' -- together they implement (from, to] precisely, and the loop simply never runs when 'to' is not after 'from'. getDayOfWeek() returns a DayOfWeek enum constant, so weekend days are excluded with two != comparisons. LocalDate is immutable: plusDays returns a NEW date, which is why the loop variable must be reassigned.
hints: Start at from.plusDays(1) so 'from' itself is never counted; stop once the day is after 'to' (!day.isAfter(to) as the loop condition).
day.getDayOfWeek() returns a java.time.DayOfWeek enum value -- compare it against SATURDAY and SUNDAY.
plusDays does not modify the date; write day = day.plusDays(1) to advance, and the leap year (2024-02-29 exists) is handled for you.
